title: Mining Engineering, B.S. (College of Earth and Mineral Sciences)
notes: Built from the archived 2024-25 bulletin (raw HTML fetched and cross-checked against its own printed subtotals, not just WebFetch's summary). Program Requirements table: 131 total credits, same figure as 2022-23 and 2023-24. Real difference found versus the 2023-24 archive: the Requirements table's Prescribed Courses list no longer resolves a title for MNG 223 (previously 'Mineral Land and Mine Surveying' in 2022-23/2023-24; here it's the bare code with no title, same as the live 2026 bulletin) -- consistent with MNG 223 having dropped out of the current PSU course catalog by this point, matching why Backend/catalogs/mng_catalog.json (this app's single, current-day course catalog) has never had it. CE 209 (the bulletin's own listed 'MNG 223 or CE 209' alternate, unchanged Suggested-Plan wording every year checked) is used exclusively here too. The Statistics slot keeps 2023-24's 'EME 210 or STAT 401' pairing (not 2022-23's STAT 301); modeled as options ['STAT 401', 'EME 210'], STAT 401 first, same reasoning as MINE-2023.json/MINE-2026.json (MNG 412 needs STAT 401 as a real prereq). Every other Requirements-table category (CMPSC 201/202, EME 301/ME 300, CE 360/EME 303, GEOSC 470W/MNG 470) is identical to prior years and to the live 2026 bulletin's 'Elective Categories' table -- MINE-2026.json's handbook-verification fixes (ME 300, CE 360 added, CMPSC 203 dropped) apply unchanged. Same real CHEM 110 -> MATH 22 -> MATH 21 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 3 hidden-prereq chain (current-catalog-driven, not year-specific) -- MATH 3/4/21/22 added for the same reason as every other year's file. REAL, substantive change from 2022-23/2023-24 found in the Suggested Academic Plan's Third Year table: this 2024-25 archive is the first to annotate individual courses '(FALL ONLY)' / '(SPRING ONLY)', and the term placement itself shifts to match -- ENGL 202C and the GHW Gen Ed move from Spring (2022-24) to Fall, while MNG 404 moves from Fall to Spring; EE 211, GEOSC 201, the EME 460/MNG 412 alternative, EME 303, MNPR 301, MNG 422, and MNG 331/MNG 441 keep the same Fall/Spring terms as before. This term arrangement matches MINE-2026.json's Semester 5/6 placement exactly (the live 2026 plan carries this same 2024-25 structure forward unchanged), so Semesters 5-6 below mirror MINE-2026.json's item placement rather than MINE-2022.json's/MINE-2023.json's. MNG 412 is still added as its own standalone item (alongside EME 460) for the same real MNG 451W capstone AND-chain reason documented in every other year's file -- the 2024-25 Suggested Plan itself still only lists 'EME 460 or MNG 412' as one alternative pick. 'At which campus can I study this program?' section of this archived page: Begin Campus 'Any Penn State Campus', End Campus 'University Park' only, same as every year checked -- see MINE-2026.json for this major's full campus-check finding. The 'Mining Engineering, B.S. at Commonwealth Campuses' Suggested Academic Plan on this same page now states a 130-132 total-credit range (vs. 2022-24's flat 132) but its course list and the EMCH 211+EMCH 213 substitution for EMCH 210 are unchanged.
